Airbnb Raises Outlook as It Remains Insulated from Global Conflicts

The company posted a third-quarter profit of $1.89 billion, or $3.16 a share

By

Airbnb ABNB -0.00 % increase; up pointing triangle raised its outlook for the year as the company has avoided the slowdown in travel demand being experienced by some of its competitors.

The short-term rental company said it now expects annual revenue to increase by a high-teens percentage, up from its prior guidance of mid-teens percentage growth.
